## Names

<a id="actor_frame_base"></a>
### [`actor_frame_base`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L8) `$59A5-$59A7`

*data*

First animation frame of each actor type, 3 bytes, indexed by the actor type (bits 7-6 of actor_flags,x: 0 = Bruce, 1 = Ninja, 2 = Yamo). Values: 0 (Bruce frames 0-69), 140 (Ninja frames 140-209), 70 (Yamo frames 70-139). set_actor_pose adds it to actor_pose,x to get actor_frame_a,x; the second sprite uses that frame + 1.

- **Referred to by:** [`set_actor_pose`](actor_poses.md#set_actor_pose) [`$29B3`](../../../src/actor_poses.asm#L336)

<a id="actor_collision_code_first"></a>
### [`actor_collision_code_first`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L13) `$59A8-$59AA`

*data*

Collision code of the first sprite of each actor type (index = type: Bruce, Ninja, Yamo): 4, 3, 6. spawn_actor stores it in actor_collision_code_a,x; set_sprite_slot_owner turns a code 3-7 into a hardware sprite number through collision_code_to_sprite and writes the actor there in sprite_owner.

- **Referred to by:** [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor) [`$0B9A`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L29)

<a id="actor_collision_code_second"></a>
### [`actor_collision_code_second`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L17) `$59AB-$59AD`

*data*

Collision code of the second sprite of each actor type (Bruce, Ninja, Yamo): 5, 0, 7. 0 = no second sprite (the Ninja is one black sprite). spawn_actor stores it in actor_collision_code_b,x.

- **Referred to by:** [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor) [`$0BA4`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L33)

<a id="collision_code_to_sprite"></a>
### [`collision_code_to_sprite`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L22) `$59AE-$59B2`

*data*

Hardware sprite number (0-4) of each collision code 3-7, read by set_sprite_slot_owner with Y = code - 3: codes 3,4,5,6,7 give 4,0,1,2,3. Codes 4/5 are Bruce's sprites 0/1, 6/7 Yamo's sprites 2/3, 3 the Ninja's sprite 4. The result indexes sprite_owner.

- **Referred to by:** [`set_sprite_slot_owner`](actor_spawn.md#set_sprite_slot_owner) [`$0E25`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L424)

<a id="unused_bit_masks"></a>
### [`unused_bit_masks`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L26) `$59B3-$59BC`

*data*

Unused. Five single-bit masks ($01,$02,$04,$08,$10) and their five-bit complements ($1E,$1D,$1B,$17,$0F). No code reads them (collision_code_to_sprite ends at $59B2).

<a id="frame_gfx_lo"></a>
### [`frame_gfx_lo`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L34) `$59BD-$5A8E`

*data*

Address of the 1-bit graphics of each of the 210 animation frames: 210 low bytes here, 210 high bytes at frame_gfx_hi. Frames 0-69 Bruce, 70-139 Yamo, 140-209 Ninja. Even frame = first sprite, odd frame = second sprite of the same pose (the Ninja uses only even frames; his odd entries are $0000). Readers: setup_sprite_frame (patches the LDA operands of the sprite builder copy_sprite_frame) and expand_contact_mask (start-up builder of the contact masks).

- **Referred to by:** [`setup_sprite_frame`](actor_sprites.md#setup_sprite_frame) [`$2719`](../../../src/actor_sprites.asm#L279), [`expand_contact_mask`](frame_builder.md#expand_contact_mask) [`$517E`](../../../src/frame_builder.asm#L94)

<a id="frame_gfx_hi"></a>
### [`frame_gfx_hi`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L63) `$5A8F-$5B60`

*data*

High bytes of the frame graphics addresses (see frame_gfx_lo).

- **Referred to by:** [`setup_sprite_frame`](actor_sprites.md#setup_sprite_frame) [`$2725`](../../../src/actor_sprites.asm#L283), [`expand_contact_mask`](frame_builder.md#expand_contact_mask) [`$5183`](../../../src/frame_builder.asm#L96)

<a id="frame_last_row"></a>
### [`frame_last_row`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L95) `$5B61-$5C32`

*data*

Height code of each frame, 210 bytes, indexed by frame. Narrow frame (frame_is_wide = 0): the frame has value + 1 rows of 1 byte. Wide frame: the sprite builder copy_sprite_frame draws value rows of 2 bytes; the mask builder expand_contact_mask reads value + 1 rows, one row past the frame (the 2 bytes after it in memory). setup_sprite_frame loads it in Y; it ends in actor_frame_height,x.

- **Referred to by:** [`setup_sprite_frame`](actor_sprites.md#setup_sprite_frame) [`$2731`](../../../src/actor_sprites.asm#L287), [`expand_contact_mask`](frame_builder.md#expand_contact_mask) [`$5188`](../../../src/frame_builder.asm#L98)

<a id="frame_colour"></a>
### [`frame_colour`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L126) `$5C33-$5CBE`

*data*

Sprite colour of each frame, 140 bytes for frames 0-139 (written to SP0COL+n by show_actor_sprites): $F7 yellow (Bruce's skin), $F5 green (Yamo), $F0 black (the dark layer of both). The Ninja (actor 2) does not read it: setup_sprite_frame uses $F0 (black).

- **Referred to by:** [`setup_sprite_frame`](actor_sprites.md#setup_sprite_frame) [`$273E`](../../../src/actor_sprites.asm#L294)

<a id="frame_is_wide"></a>
### [`frame_is_wide`](../../../src/actor_frame_tables.asm#L148) `$5CBF-$5D90`

*data*

Width flag of each frame, 210 bytes: 0 = 8 pixels (1 byte per row), nonzero ($01 or $55) = 16 pixels (2 bytes per row). Read by setup_sprite_frame (picks the sprite builder path; when actor_facing,x is not 1 (left), show_actor_sprites subtracts 8 from the X position, 16 screen pixels) and by expand_contact_mask.

- **Referred to by:** [`setup_sprite_frame`](actor_sprites.md#setup_sprite_frame) [`$2742`](../../../src/actor_sprites.asm#L297), [`expand_contact_mask`](frame_builder.md#expand_contact_mask) [`$51B2`](../../../src/frame_builder.asm#L119)
